Power-up state is unspecified by the problem; functional checks start with a synchronous reset.
implementation: Four positive-edge D flip-flop stages with synchronous active-low reset to zero; out is the fourth stage.
verification: Independent stage-array oracle checks input propagation, reset priority, repeated resets, between-edge reset pulses, falling-edge stability, alternating and pseudorandom data.
